coordinate_system.generator_local: x east/right; y south/down; integer units; (0,0) is the NW corner of the generated settlement canvas
coordinate_system.unity_note: Do not assume generator y equals Unity +Z. Route XY through the project's existing world-coordinate adapter; if +Z is south use z=y, if +Z is north use z=-y with the appropriate world offset.

ownership_contract.cross_pixel_building: owned once; every other intersected pixel references the same building ID
ownership_contract.doors: owned by building; chunk door list is spatial convenience only
ownership_contract.streets: parent network entity in entities.json; geometry clipped into per-pixel segments
ownership_contract.districts: settlement-level entities; chunks list touching district IDs
